title: Theme components and palettes
description: As a user I want themed components
acceptance_criteria: THM-03 to THM-09 backlog rows pass

title: Shared UI components
description: As a user I want shared save/cancel pairs and resize bars
acceptance_criteria: UIC-14 to UIC-17; UIC-27 to UIC-37 backlog rows pass

title: Calendar event drag and resize
description: As a user I want to move events and resize the calendar

title: Event dialog
description: As a user I want to open an event and add edit and remove my own events in a dialog
acceptance_criteria: EVT-01 to EVT-03 and EVT-07 and their sub-rows pass; clicking an event opens its details

title: Local event store
description: As a user I want my events kept on my device
acceptance_criteria: Events persist across restarts in UTC with their zones (TIM-01); a removed custom event can be undone (CAP-02)

title: Header time zone and clock controls
description: As a user I want to look at another time zone and switch 12h or 24h from the calendar header
acceptance_criteria: CAL-02; CAL-06.a; CAL-06.b; CAL-06.c; CAL-06.d; CAL-06.e; SET-02.a pass

title: Calendar height and Full page
description: As a user I want to change how tall the calendar is and use Full page

title: Location address autocomplete
description: As a user I want addresses suggested while I type a location
acceptance_criteria: EVT-03.n passes; suggestions come from Photon (Product Owner decision 2026-11-22; hosting public or self-hosted still to decide); the map button keeps opening Google Maps (EVT-03.a)
